text.title: AI Pre-Screen Bias Guardrails — Output Contract
text.summary: The guardrail spec is one JSON document with one section per rule in 01-core-rules.xml: the redaction step and the ten attribute classes it strips, the versioned and hashed rubric with anchors, the proxy-criteria review, the real-pool calibration with a pre-set agreement threshold, per-stage four-fifths monitoring, the human of record, the applicable automated-employment-decision law with notice and bias audit, the per-candidate audit log with its retention, and the pinned model / prompt / rubric / redaction tuple. Subagent MUST satisfy this contract before returning to caller.

required.field: the role the pre-screen or take-home review is used for
where candidates apply from; drives which law applies (r-candidate-notice-and-bias-audit)
version, all ten stripped attribute classes, unit_tested true, fixture path, human sample inspected per release (r-protected-attributes-stripped-before-model)
version, sha256 hash, written_before_first_score true, criteria each mapped to a job requirement with low / mid / high anchors (r-rubric-versioned-before-first-score)
date of the review against the proxy list, zero proxy terms found, evidence URL (r-no-proxy-criteria-in-prompt)
sample from the real applicant pool, at least two blind human reviewers, statistic, threshold set before the run, result, run URL, passed (r-calibration-sample-before-go-live)
self-ID store separate from scoring; per-stage selection rates by group; ratio below 0.8 puts the system on hold (r-adverse-impact-monitored-per-stage)
no auto-reject filter; every decision carries a role:handle; the reviewer sees the redacted document and the score (r-human-of-record-decides)
which AEDT law applies; notice text and independent bias audit when one does; the counsel who confirmed when none does (r-candidate-notice-and-bias-audit)
all seven fields retained per candidate, retention of at least 12 months, queryable per candidate (r-per-candidate-audit-log-retained)
model_id, prompt_hash, rubric_version, redaction_version — any change re-runs calibration and the proxy review (fm-model-swap-resets-nothing)
URLs: calibration run, proxy review, bias audit summary, per-stage four-fifths table

forbidden.pattern: redaction.stripped_attributes missing any of the ten classes, or unit_tested false (fm-proxy-leaks-through-redaction)
rubric.written_before_first_score false, a criterion without all three anchors, or a criterion with no job_requirement (fm-rubric-written-after-scores)

proxy_review.proxy_terms_found non-empty — "culture fit", "energy", "polish", "native speaker", "recent graduate", "digital native", employment gaps, years since graduation, commute distance, school or employer prestige
calibration.sample_source other than real-applicant-pool, fewer than two reviewers, or threshold_set_before_run false (fm-calibration-on-synthetic-cvs)
human_of_record.auto_reject_filter_present true, or a decision record without a role:handle (fm-threshold-auto-reject)
adverse_impact.per_stage empty, or a stage whose min_ratio is below 0.8 with on_hold false (fm-four-fifths-never-computed)
legal.applicable_law none without confirmed_by, or nyc-ll-144 without notice_lead_business_days of at least 10 and a bias audit within the year
audit_log.retention_months under 12, or fewer than the seven fields; pinned_tuple differing from the tuple on the last calibration run

allowed-transformations.transformation: Where self-identification is collected by a separate HR system, reference its table in adverse_impact.self_id_store rather than copying counts into the scoring pipeline.
Record a longer retention_months than the statutory floor where a state or national rule requires it; never a shorter one.
Where several roles share one rubric, produce one spec per role with the same rubric hash rather than one spec for all roles.

list.item: redaction strips all ten attribute classes, is unit-tested on a fixture set, and a human inspects a sample every release.
rubric is versioned and hashed before the first score; every criterion maps to a job requirement and has low, mid and high anchors.
proxy_review found zero proxy terms and its evidence URL is in evidence[].
calibration used the real applicant pool, at least two blind reviewers, a threshold set before the run, and the run URL is in evidence[]; result at or above threshold means passed.
adverse_impact has a per-stage table from a self-ID store held apart from scoring; any stage with min_ratio under 0.8 is on_hold.
No auto-reject filter; every decision carries a role:handle; the reviewer sees the redacted document and the score.
legal names the applicable law with notice text and an independent bias audit, or none with the counsel who confirmed it; NYC LL 144 has at least 10 business days of notice.
audit_log retains all seven fields for at least 12 months and is queryable per candidate; pinned_tuple matches the tuple on the last calibration run.
